ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; visual pixel distribution ratio of high-intensity white base to low-intensity black pigmentation is approximately 65:35.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal lobes feature a white base with high-frequency black spotting; the central area around the notch and the entirety of the trailing edge show contiguous black pigmentation with low-frequency white circular spotting.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (serrations) with several distinct larger notches on the inner trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a strong convex curvature towards the distal tips; trailing edges follow a concave sweep towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle scars) distributed throughout dark pigmented zones; significant accumulation of barnacles at the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear rake marks visible; multiple parallel diagonal marks across the right-center lobe and several disparate horizontal scratches on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both lobes; heavy barnacle colonization and associated tissue distortion at the extreme distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy three-dimensional barnacle encrustation at the lobe tips that disrupts the linear continuity of the trailing edge contour.
